```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, fig.width = 7, fig.height = 4.5)
library(Lock5Data)
library(mosaic)
library(lattice)
```

## 1. Study Overview
This empirical case study investigates whether opening weekend box office receipts (`OpeningWeekend`, in millions USD) effectively predict lifetime total worldwide gross (`WorldGross`, in millions USD) for feature films in the `HollywoodMovies` dataset ($n = 970$).

## 2. Exploratory Visualization & Correlation
```{r visual-correlation}
data(HollywoodMovies)

# Scatterplot with OLS regression line
xyplot(WorldGross ~ OpeningWeekend, type = c("p", "r"), data = HollywoodMovies,
       xlab = "Opening Weekend ($ Millions)", ylab = "World Gross ($ Millions)",
       main = "Worldwide Gross vs. Opening Weekend Revenue", pch = 19, col = "darkred")

# Pearson correlation coefficient
r_val <- cor(WorldGross ~ OpeningWeekend, use = "pairwise.complete", data = HollywoodMovies)
cat("Correlation (r):", round(r_val, 4), "\n")
cat("Coefficient of Determination (R^2):", round(r_val^2, 4), "\n")
```

## 3. Ordinary Least Squares Regression
```{r ols-model}
lm_movies <- lm(WorldGross ~ OpeningWeekend, data = HollywoodMovies)
summary(lm_movies)
```

The fitted regression equation is:
$$\widehat{\text{WorldGross}} = 15.408 + 7.502 \times \text{OpeningWeekend}$$

## 4. Point Prediction ($50M Opening)
```{r prediction}
pred_50 <- predict(lm_movies, newdata = data.frame(OpeningWeekend = 50))
cat("Predicted World Gross for $50M Opening Weekend: $", round(pred_50, 3), "Million\n")
```

## 5. Outlier Diagnostics: The Great Gatsby (2013)
```{r outlier-analysis}
gatsby <- subset(HollywoodMovies, grepl("Gatsby", Movie))
act_open <- gatsby$OpeningWeekend[1]
act_gross <- gatsby$WorldGross[1]
pred_gatsby <- predict(lm_movies, newdata = data.frame(OpeningWeekend = act_open))
residual_gatsby <- act_gross - pred_gatsby

cat("Opening Weekend:", act_open, "Million\n")
cat("Actual World Gross:", act_gross, "Million\n")
cat("Predicted World Gross:", round(pred_gatsby, 2), "Million\n")
cat("Residual (Observed - Predicted):", round(residual_gatsby, 2), "Million\n")
```
